title: Compare Models
text: To answer this problem, we need to find when our $$2$$ models intersect. What should I do if I want to find when (what amount of minutes) one model equals the other?
choices: Set the equations equal to each other.

title: Interpret
text: Interpret each model. Because the slope is larger in y=14,000+ $$0.1x$$, the line is steeper and the slope in y=19,000+0.04*x is less steep, but starts at 19,000 instead of 14,000. Therefore, y=14,000+ $$0.1x$$ will be a higher pay option for a large enough $$x$$.

title: Interpret
text: So, when the lines intersect is when 14,000+0.10*x surpasses 19,000+0.04*x and is the larger income. $$x$$ is our answer (the value in electronics we need to sell to produce a larger income).
